create.name: Marisa La Fata
create.bio:
Marisa La Fata is a spiritual coach and meditation guide in Portland, Oregon, who works under the name Soul Alchemy Healing. Her path draws on Toltec teachings she studied with Don Miguel Ruiz Jr., Don Jose Ruiz and HeatherAsh Amara, and on Shamanic Breathwork, which she practises as a master apprentice of its founder, Linda Star Wolf. She is open about her own long recovery and about the years she spent working with people in hospitals and treatment settings, and that history gives her teaching a frank, grounded tone.

Her central method is what she calls psychospiritual meditation: unscripted, intuitively led visualisations that bring together imagery, body awareness and a sense of spiritual connection. She offers 90-minute one-to-one sessions and a twelve-week private journey over Zoom, and leads women's breathwork ceremonies and day retreats in Oregon. She hosts the Healing Our Relationships podcast, with conversations with spiritual teachers, and has written a companion workbook. On Insight Timer she shares channelled shamanic journeys, morning prayers and an eight-day course on inner visioning.

courses.title: Awakening the Heart Center: A Course In Inner Visioning
courses.description: An eight-day Insight Timer course in which Marisa guides unscripted visualisation journeys toward the heart, to build trust in your own inner sight and guidance.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Intuitive Healing Session
courses.description: A 90-minute one-to-one session on Zoom that mixes conversation with a channelled, guided journey, so you can look at your situation from a wider view and connect with your own intuition and guides.

courses.title: 12 Week Soul Return
courses.description: A private twelve-week programme of weekly 90-minute Zoom sessions with messaging support in between. Sessions draw on guided meditation, archetypes, tarot, breath, art and ritual, shaped around what comes up each week.

courses.title: Rise of the Sacred Feminine: Women's Shamanic Breathwork Day Retreat
courses.description: A one-day women's retreat in a yurt near Sisters, Oregon, built around a Shamanic Breathwork ceremony with chakra-attuned music, art and sharing circle. Places are limited to twelve, with sliding-scale fees.

free_resources.title: Marisa La Fata on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free channelled shamanic journeys, prayers and guided meditations from Marisa, recorded without scripts. Listen in the app or on the web.
